title: Allosteric mechanism of MntR transcription factor from alkalophilic bacterium Halalkalibacterium halodurans.
authors: Knez, Ana Marija; Manenica, Martina; Jelic Matosevic, Zoe; Bertosa, Branimir
one_liner_zh: 该文通过长时程全原子MD模拟研究嗜碱菌MntR转录因子在Mn2+结合下的别构机制，揭示其如何改变DNA结合域构象与DNA结合亲和力，属于TF-DNA互作动态机理的物理模拟研究，高度契合本课题。
abstract: Bacterium Halalkalibacterium halodurans is an industrially important alkalophilic bacteria. It is recognized as a producer of enzymes such as beta-galactosidase, xylanase, amylase and protease which are able to function at higher pH values and thus can be used in textile, food, paper industry and more. This bacterium, as any other bacterium, requires a sensitive mechanism for regulation of homeostasis of manganese ions (Mn(2+)) in order to survive. The key protein regulating this mechanism in H. halodurans is MntR - a transcriptional factor that binds to DNA and regulates the transcription of genes for proteins involved in manganese homeostasis. Long range all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, from 500 ns up to 1.25 micros, were used to study different forms of H. halodurans MntR in order to investigate the differences in the protein's structural and dynamical properties upon Mn(2+) binding. Simulations revealed an allosteric mechanism which is activated by Mn(2+) binding. The results of simulations show that Mn(2+) binding alters the non-covalent interaction network of the protein structure which leads to a conformational change that primarily affects the positions of the DNA binding domains and, consequently, the DNA binding affinity of H. halodurans MntR. The key amino acid residues of the proposed mechanism were identified and their role in the proposed mechanism was computationally confirmed by MD simulations of in silico mutants.
abstract_zh: 细菌Halalkalibacterium halodurans是一种工业上重要的嗜碱细菌。它被认为是β-半乳糖苷酶 (beta-galactosidase)、木聚糖酶 (xylanase)、淀粉酶 (amylase) 和蛋白酶 (protease) 等酶的生产者，这些酶能够在较高pH值下发挥作用，因此可用于纺织、食品、造纸等行业。与其他细菌一样，该细菌需要一种敏感的机制来调节锰离子 (Mn(2+)) 的稳态以维持生存。在H. halodurans中，调控这一机制的关键蛋白是MntR——一种转录因子，它结合DNA并调节参与锰稳态的蛋白质基因的转录。本研究使用长程全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟，时间从500纳秒到1.25微秒不等，以研究H. halodurans MntR的不同形式，从而探究Mn(2+)结合后蛋白质结构和动力学性质的差异。模拟揭示了一种由Mn(2+)结合激活的变构机制。模拟结果表明，Mn(2+)结合改变了蛋白质结构的非共价相互作用网络，导致构象变化，主要影响DNA结合域的位置，进而影响H. halodurans MntR的DNA结合亲和力。所提出机制中的关键氨基酸残基已被识别，并通过计算模拟突变体的MD模拟，在计算上确认了它们在该机制中的作用。
